name: Alpaca Connectors
description: Agent-ready project card for the Alpaca Connectors repository. The repository is organized around Assets, Universes, Market Data, Accounts, Holdings, Portfolios, and Operations; its current agent skills expose the supported CLI workflows without treating providers as a separate Connection domain.

skills.name: Asset Registration
skills.description: Plan or execute the repository's strict asset-registration workflow through `alpaca-connectors asset register`, including exact Alpaca symbol registration and ETF-seed expansion through a supported component provider, with OpenFIGI resolution required before assets are written.
examples: Register NVDA and AAPL through the supported asset registration flow.

skills.name: Holdings Category
skills.description: Manage durable UniverseSource rows and plan or execute source-UID-backed synchronization, materializing an AssetCategory only when extracted constituents resolve cleanly to registered assets.
examples: Create or refresh a holdings-backed universe after confirming all extracted holdings are registered.

skills.name: Stock Bars
skills.description: Maintain reusable Alpaca bar configurations, resolve explicit Assets, active universes, or recent account holdings, query migrated price datasets, and execute updates through the reusable AlpacaStockBarsNode without accepting an output dataset UID.
examples: Resolve a stored daily bar configuration without running the node.
